title: Certify QF_UFLRA refutations in Lean through both proof cores
summary: Adds the fragment qf_uflra so inputs mixing uninterpreted functions or sorts with linear real arithmetic are exported through both proof cores and certified in Lean with two new binders for Real arguments and Real-valued functions. Merged on the local gate after an approving review; about 130 random instances and nine adversarial inputs verified under the standard axioms.
